purpose: Author real four-pose artwork for every remaining catalog creature and every custom avatar base. Keep all existing creature identities and the18 already authored catalog pose sets.

releaseAllocation.note: 112 is only the next potential number after111. No ASC query/reservation/allocation is performed by this plan; inspect complete live history and both source lines before choosing it.

generationMethod.note: Use the supplied existing atlas references as identity guides. This plan does not generate or edit raster pixels, install packages or call an image API.

inventory.definition: Authored means all four required pose names resolve to four different source rectangles; manual review must additionally prove meaningful different drawn poses, since different rectangles alone can still contain duplicates.

grouping.policy: Keep complete four-row groups from each current source atlas together. Pack17 leftover catalog rows into five jobs with exact per-row source metadata and one or two source references plus the core style reference. Custom bases occupy final three jobs.

importerAudit.blockingCustomRequirement: The motion importer asserts every ID belongs to manifest.sprites and updates that section only. Add a reviewed section-aware path for customBases before importing jobs33-35; do not put custom IDs into sprites or use the single-pose importer, which overwrites frames with idle only.
importerAudit.metadataShape: Current motion importer reads an array of {key,path,ids}; section is presently ignored. Generate that metadata only after image creation/review. This planning object is not directly runnable importer metadata.

connectedComponentContract.connectivity: scipy.ndimage.label default 2D cross connectivity; substantial disconnected limbs/props create extra components
connectedComponentContract.rowSort: ascending component bottom edge, then left edge within each four-component row
connectedComponentContract.foreignComponentRejection: Rejects any other >1000px component inside the padded crop.

constraints: Rows must have aligned baselines and nonoverlapping vertical bands so bottom-edge ordering cannot mix neighboring rows.
Every creature must form one substantial connected silhouette per pose; held shields/staffs, wings, tails and stone/leaf features remain connected.
Each cell requires clear alpha gutters and complete visible anatomy; unsupported detached visual effects must not be silently discarded.
Current importer copies PNG bytes unchanged, retains existing row metadata/archetype and replaces asset/frames. New unique asset keys avoid overwriting shipped sources.
Current importer does not enforce unique metadata IDs/assets or prevent existing asset overwrite; verify those before running.
All inputs are parsed before its write loop, but writes are not a transaction; retain source-control recovery and verify manifest/asset completeness after any interruption.

Current validator requires known catalog IDs, expected12 custom bases, legal poses and archetypes, RGBA images <=4096px per dimension, valid crop bounds, transparent crop padding and no shared opaque crop pixels. Its --require-complete checks roster coverage, not full four-pose coverage.

Completion requires an added explicit all143+12 four-distinct-pose check plus visual review, and native custom pose/cache/animation verification; do not infer animation completeness from current --require-complete alone.
importerAudit.noChangesMade: Neither importer, manifest, assets, version, nor release code is modified by this plan.
importerAudit.requiredStorageChange: Root/engine plan a section-aware motion importer plus bundled raw PNG resources instead of UIImage named asset-atlas loading, to avoid retaining all large animation atlases in the global image cache. This is planned work outside this document; current importer still writes imagesets.
importerAudit.auditBasis: Importer behavior audited from source at756335e; customBases/raw-resource support is requested for the next implementation and must be verified after those changes land.

reviewAndCompletion: Inspect each generated original against its listed source rows before import; reject duplicated idle drawings, identity drift, missing/extra limbs/heads, clipped appendages, floating props, unequal body scale or unreadable 80px silhouettes.
Measure and review all four crops after import; image dimensions may differ from prompt, so do not hardcode cell crops. Retain original generated PNGs and provenance/hash records.
Preserve the18 completed pose sets and all143 gameplay IDs,12 custom-base keys, archetype metadata, model schemas and release identity.

All final143 catalog entries and12 custom bases must expose idle/anticipation/attack/reaction as independently drawn poses. Authored artwork should use the existing authored-animation path; procedural fallback should remain an intentional fallback, not be counted as finished artwork.

Validate current iOS roster/manifest, custom first-creation and pose cache, native solo/4v4/custom animation, Reduce Motion, exported portraits, app-size/memory and release build after all groups are reviewed. Rendering one sheet is not completion of this125+12 plan.
